Your club & week

One weekly shop for this club.

Which session?
Exclude foods children cannot have

Tick foods to leave out of every menu and shopping list. The planner will choose alternatives where possible. These are ingredient exclusions, not an allergen suitability check. Check every product label and your club’s dietary records.

Set a day to 0 if the club is closed. Adjust the menu for each day.

Portions & extra allowance

100% is our planning estimate, not a JAG portion standard. Fruit: 1 small piece; vegetables: 40g; fillings: chicken 25g or cheese 20g; dip: 10g. Breakfast: 25g cereal, 150ml milk and 1 slice of toast. Adjust to your children and provision. Keep total condiments within the approved daily limit.

Make the budget work

Allow for food and getting it to your club.

The £3.50 slot fee is a planning placeholder. Replace it with your booked fee, including £0 for an eligible Delivery Saver slot. A small-order charge can still apply.

One order per week. Period forecast repeats this week’s attendance, prices and fees, with fresh full packs each week. It does not carry leftovers into later weeks.

The week’s menu

Approved foods & planning notes

Built from the JAG “Approved food Lists.pdf” supplied on 22 October 2026. It contains one shared approved ingredient list and a page of serving ideas. The breakfast and after-school menus here organise foods from that shared list; the PDF does not specify separate session lists.

Breakfast selection: plain oats / low or no added sugar corn flakes, wholemeal toast, light spread, milk and fruit.

After-school selection: wholemeal sliced bread, pittas and wraps; chicken, cheddar or houmous; carrots, cucumber and peppers; bananas, apples and satsumas.

Other approved foods and alternatives in the source are not all modelled in this starter. Check the club’s dietary records and product labels before choosing foods. This planner does not certify allergen-free or special-diet meals.

The source limits condiments to 10g / one teaspoon across the school day, and jam and honey to at most once or twice a week. Jam and honey are not used in these menus. Plan chilled use-by dates and safe storage across the week; stock totals do not account for food spoiling after opening.

Planning portions, pack yields and produce counts are approximate. A 600g bag of easy peelers is estimated as 8 fruit; a cucumber as 300g usable; bread as 20 slices. Update these when your pack differs.

Tesco minimum-order guidance ↗: researched 22 October 2026, £5 under £50 for grocery home delivery; £5 under £25 for Click+Collect. Fees and thresholds are editable. This planner covers standard grocery shops, not Whoosh.

Your plan saves only in this browser on this device. Staff plans are not shared or synchronised. Only enter attendance counts, not children’s names.
